rows.grounds: Token treated as given fused string; sustanā from su-stana (good breasts), yauvanāṃgā from yauvana-aṅga (youthful limbs) with internal sandhi noted in form, ca indeclinable conjunction; describes feminine bodily marks in this descriptive series.
Compound sarva-ābharaṇa-bhūṣitā read as given fused form; past-participial/adjectival description meaning adorned with all ornaments, agreeing with the described feminine form in context.
